jobs.title: Management Consulting Director, Technology Performance
jobs.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

RSM is seeking a Director to join our Technology Performance practice within Management Consulting. This role will lead large-scale transformation engagements for Consumer and Industrial Products clients, helping organizations improve operational performance, modernize technology ecosystems, and accelerate digital transformation initiatives.

The Director will serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, leading engagements across manufacturing operations, supply chain, engineering, and enterprise technology functions. This individual will drive strategic initiatives spanning ERP, MES, PLM, WMS, analytics, AI, and Industry 4.0 capabilities while helping clients translate technology investments into measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines deep manufacturing operations expertise with a strong understanding of enterprise and manufacturing technology architectures. They should be capable of advising clients across the manufacturing technology stack, including ERP, MES, PLM, WMS, industrial automation, data architecture, analytics, and emerging Industry 4.0 capabilities. This leader will help clients connect operational strategy with technology execution, translating complex technical concepts into measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

Client Leadership & Delivery

Lead complex consulting engagements focused on operational performance, technology modernization, and digital transformation.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders across operations, supply chain, engineering, and technology organizations.
Develop transformation roadmaps, operating models, business cases, and technology strategies.
Manage engagement scope, budget, quality, and delivery outcomes.

Manufacturing & Technology Transformation

Advise clients on manufacturing technology architecture and integration strategies spanning operational technology (OT), manufacturing systems, enterprise applications, and analytics environment
Lead assessments and strategy development across ERP, MES, PLM, WMS, planning, analytics, and emerging technology platforms.
Support system selection, implementation planning, and enterprise transformation programs.
Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, analytics, and Industry 4.0 technologies to improve performance.

Practice Growth & Business Development

Lead proposal development, client pursuits, and account expansion activities.
Develop executive relationships and identify opportunities to grow existing client engagements.
Contribute to thought leadership, market-facing initiatives, and practice development efforts.

Talent & Team Development

Mentor and develop consulting professionals across multiple levels.
Foster a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Support recruiting, retention, and workforce planning efforts.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in management consulting, manufacturing operations, technology transformation, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale transformation programs and client engagements.
Experience advising executive-level stakeholders and driving strategic initiatives.
Proven success leading operational improvement, digital transformation, or enterprise technology implementations.
Strong knowledge of manufacturing operations, supply chain, engineering, and operational performance improvement.
Experience with ERP, MES, PLM, WMS, supply chain planning, or manufacturing technology platforms.
Understanding of Industry 4.0, AI, analytics, automation, and digital transformation trends.
Strong communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to travel up to 50% throughout North America.

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or advanced degree preferred.
Experience within Consumer Products, Industrial Products, Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense, Automotive, or Industrial Equipment industries.
Prior experience at a Big Four, national consulting firm, or specialized operations/technology consulting practice.
Lean Six Sigma, APICS, or related professional certifications.
Experience leading ERP, MES, PLM, WMS, or digital transformation programs.
Knowledge of AI, analytics, industrial IoT, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmcanada.com/careers/life-at-rsm/rewards-and-benefits.html.

We believe flexibility and in-person connection both play an important role in how we work and grow. Most roles at RSM follow a hybrid workstyle, which means team members are aligned to an RSM office and come together in person when it best supports clients, teams, development or relationship-building. Some roles may be virtual or primarily on-site based on role requirements, team priorities and client needs.

RSM does not tolerate discrimination and/or harassment based on race; colour; creed; sincerely held religious beliefs, practices or observances; sex (including pregnancy or disabilities related to nursing); gender (including gender identity and/or gender expression); sexual orientation; national origin; ancestry; familial or marital status; age; physical or mental disability; citizenship; political affiliation; medical condition (including family and medical leave); domestic violence victim status; past, current or prospective service in the Canadian uniformed service; Canadian Military/Veteran status; pre-disposing genetic characteristics or any other characteristic protected under applicable provincial employment legislation.

Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process and/or employment/partnership. RSM is committed to providing equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, interview, or otherwise participate in the recruiting process, please call us at 800-274-3978 or send us an email at careers@rsmus.com.

At RSM, an employee’s pay at any point in their career is intended to reflect their experiences, performance, and skills for their current role. The salary range (or starting rate for interns and associates) for this role represents numerous factors considered in the hiring decisions including, but not limited to, education, skills, work experience, certifications, location, etc. As such, pay for the successful candidate(s) could fall anywhere within the stated range.

Compensation Range: $138,000 - $253,300

Individuals selected for this role will be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on firm and individual performance.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Location:
Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario, Canada.

This is a full-time, in-person position. The CTO will play a central role in establishing and leading Martell Ventures' Waterloo technical hub.

Salary:
$150,000- $250,000 CAD base.

The opportunity also includes a proposed portfolio-level phantom equity component designed to align long-term incentives with the performance and success of the Ventures portfolio. Final terms are subject to confirmation.

About Martell Group

The Martell Group exists to build people, brands, and ventures that create meaningful impact. Across our four companies, we combine audience, operators, and execution to launch scalable products and empower ambitious leaders in Media, B2B SaaS, and AI.

Founded by serial entrepreneur and investor Dan Martell (investor in Udemy, Intercom, and Unbounce), we're building a company that values leadership, growth, and simplicity, and we're looking for people who live those values too.

Our goal is to attract world-class talent and align people where their impact is greatest. When you apply to Martell Group, you'll automatically be considered for all open roles across our companies, not just the one you applied for.

Position Responsibilities

Martell Ventures is looking for a highly technical builder and strategic thinker to lead engineering excellence across its growing portfolio of businesses.

This is not a traditional CTO role focused solely on executive oversight. We need someone who can think strategically, challenge assumptions, and get directly involved in the technical work when it matters most.

You will be the technical authority across the Ventures portfolio, helping companies build better products, solve complex engineering challenges, strengthen technical teams, and move faster with modern AI and agentic development.

You'll work closely with Dan Martell, portfolio business leaders, and experienced technology advisors to turn ambitious ideas into practical, scalable solutions.

A significant part of your mandate will be establishing Martell Ventures' technical presence in Waterloo, building a strong local engineering community, and creating the standards that enable our portfolio companies to scale.

This is an opportunity to shape how multiple businesses build, operate, and grow while remaining close to the technology itself.

What You'll Do

Technical Strategy & Architecture

Evaluate the technical infrastructure, architecture, codebases, and engineering practices across portfolio companies, identifying opportunities to improve quality, security, scalability, and performance.
Work directly with engineering teams to diagnose technical challenges, improve architecture, and implement practical solutions.
Establish consistent engineering standards, shared development practices, frameworks, and tooling across the portfolio.
Drive adoption of modern AI and agentic development practices to improve engineering speed, efficiency, and product delivery.
Ensure portfolio companies maintain appropriate technical infrastructure, security practices, backups, and operational resilience.
Help portfolio leaders understand technical risks, opportunities, and priorities so they can make informed business decisions.
Support technical readiness for future acquisitions, investment opportunities, and potential exits.

Building & Developing Technical Talent

Establish and grow Martell Ventures' technical presence in Kitchener-Waterloo.
Help recruit, assess, and develop exceptional engineering talent across the portfolio.
Partner with portfolio business leaders on technical hiring decisions, including engineering leads and senior technical positions.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to portfolio engineering leaders while maintaining a dotted-line relationship with those leaders.
Establish consistent technical practices, knowledge-sharing, and training opportunities across portfolio teams.
Develop relationships with the University of Waterloo, Communitech, and the broader Waterloo technology ecosystem to build a sustainable talent pipeline.
Collaborate with Waterloo-based technology advisors Michael Litt and Marcelo Cortes to strengthen the group's engineering capabilities and local network.

Product Development & Execution

Translate ambitious business ideas into practical technical plans with clear priorities, realistic timelines, and measurable outcomes.
Provide hands-on technical support when portfolio companies face complex engineering challenges or execution bottlenecks.
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and help prioritize technical investments based on business value.
Support engineering teams in delivering reliable, scalable products that meet customer needs.
Identify opportunities to share technical capabilities, infrastructure, and resources across portfolio businesses.
Balance long-term technical architecture with the immediate needs of fast-moving businesses.

Strategic Partnership & Leadership

Serve as a trusted technical thought partner to Dan Martell and the Ventures leadership team.
Bring independent technical judgment, including the confidence to challenge ideas, push back on unrealistic commitments, and recommend alternative approaches.
Help establish a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Work across multiple businesses and priorities while maintaining a clear focus on the highest-impact opportunities.
Communicate technical decisions, risks, and progress clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Lead by example through a combination of strategic thinking, practical execution, and strong technical credibility.

What You Bring

We are looking for someone with exceptional technical depth, strong product judgment, and the ability to build in fast-moving environments.

You may have held a CTO or VP of Engineering position, or you may be an exceptional Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or technical founder ready to take on broader responsibility.

What matters most is your ability to solve difficult technical problems, raise engineering standards, and build products that work.

Deep hands-on experience in software engineering, systems architecture, and building scalable production applications.
Recent, practical experience developing with modern AI technologies, LLMs, agents, and agentic development tools.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate existing software architecture, identify technical weaknesses, and implement effective solutions.
Strong technical credibility and the ability to work directly with experienced engineers on complex technical challenges.
Experience building and shipping software products in startup, scale-up, or similarly fast-moving environments.
Strong product and business judgment, with an understanding of how technical decisions affect customers, revenue, and growth.
Experience assessing engineering talent, making technical hiring decisions, and helping build high-performing teams.
Ability to balance technical quality with speed, pragmatism, and commercial priorities.
Confidence working with strong founder personalities and challenging ideas when necessary.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business recommendations.
High ownership, adaptability, and comfort operating across multiple businesses with changing priorities.

Preferred:

Previous experience as a CTO, technical co-founder, VP of Engineering, or senior technical leader.
Experience supporting multiple products, portfolio companies, or venture-backed businesses.
Experience building or scaling an engineering function from an early stage.
Involvement in a successful company exit or technical due diligence process.
Existing connections within the Waterloo technology ecosystem, including the University of Waterloo or Communitech.
Experience establishing engineering standards and shared infrastructure across multiple teams.

Our Ideal Teammate Is Someone Who:

Is a builder at heart and genuinely enjoys getting into the technical details.
Is excited by the pace of change in AI and is actively experimenting with emerging tools and technologies.
Can move comfortably between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
Knows when to challenge an idea, when to simplify a solution, and when to move quickly.
Has strong technical opinions but remains open to learning and feedback.
Thrives in entrepreneurial environments where priorities evolve and ownership matters.
Is proactive and accountable.
Thinks strategically and executes consistently.
Communicates with clarity and confidence.
Brings a positive, growth-oriented mindset.
Is highly organized and dependable.
Cares deeply about building great products and developing great people.

This isn't just a job. It's a platform to build, grow, and win.

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Media Production

jobs.title: Regional Digital B&P Leader
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and coordinating competitive technical and commercial proposals, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and profitability. You will work closely with sales teams, customers, and internal stakeholders to deliver tailored solutions that meet customer needs and support business growth.

This role is Hybrid - 3 days per week

Responsibilities :

Prepare competitive and accurate proposals, estimates, and quotations aligned with customer requirements and business objectives.
Develop technical, commercial, and financial bid documentation, including pricing, scope, and delivery assumptions.
Collaborate closely with sales teams, customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders throughout the proposal process.
Coordinate bid activities to ensure quality deliverables are completed on time and in accordance with established procedures.
Maintain complete and accurate proposal documentation, including assumptions, decisions, and bid outcomes.
Identify and mitigate commercial, contractual, and project risks, engaging legal and compliance teams when required.
Gather and consolidate technical, commercial, and cost information needed to develop winning proposals.
Build strong customer relationships, provide technical support during sales discussions, and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support supplier and subcontractor evaluations, working with Supply Chain teams to secure competitive and compliant solutions.
Monitor proposal performance and capture lessons learned to continuously improve bid quality and win rates.

Qualifications :

12+ years of experience in industrial automation, digital solutions, solution consulting, proposals, sales, or project execution.
Proven experience managing large, complex, multi-technology bids.
Bachelor of Mechnical, Instrumentation or Electrical engineering
Strong understanding of digital solutions such as APM, APC/RTO, MES, EMS, Industrial AI, Analytics, Digital IOT technologies, and digital services.
Strong commercial capability in costing, pricing, margin management, contracts, and risk management.
Experience in process industries such as Mining, Pulp & Paper, Cement, Metals, Energy, or Chemicals preferred.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, and executive communication skills.
Ability to lead cross-functional and geographically distributed teams in a matrix organization.

Key Success Measures:

Order intake and revenue growth
Bid-to-win conversion
Gross/contribution margin improvement
Proposal turnaround time
Cost and pricing accuracy
On-time, compliant submissions
Growth of software, digital services, and recurring revenue
Reduction in bid-to-execution cost and scope variance

What Success Looks Like

Winning the right digital opportunities at the right price and margin, while ensuring every proposal is differentiated, competitive, scalable, and executable.

Employment Equity & Inclusion Statement (Canada)

ABB values the dedication, commitment, and expertise of all our employees. As an Employment Equity Employer, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We actively support the principles of the Employment Equity Act and strive to build a workforce that reflects Canada’s diversity, including:

Women
Indigenous Peoples
Members of visible minorities
Persons with disabilities

ABB is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we encourage you to let us know.
